source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit: the R8T2 run of the port's test steps and the C3A4 unit test
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74: in R8T2 (2026-10-18) main-rms's test passes: with the FX track's AMP page open, a loud pattern inverts the VOL label, and it clears when the output gets quieter. In C3A4 (core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods v1.2 ports, 2026-10-20) each mod's own test passed, including this one's.
scope: main-rms 1.0 beside other rytm2_mods ports, never alone. No build with the released core-ar2 0.3 has run on a unit with it yet.

builds.label: C3A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.3 as built before elekloader #153, and rytm2_mods v1.2's eleven OS 1.74 release objects. Relinking those files on stock 1.74 gives this main OS byte for byte.
results: Each mod's own test passed, including Main RMS's.

builds.label: R8T2
builds.content: core-ar2 0.1 ported to 1.74 with filter-hz, ctrl-all 1.1, env-reset-amp, slice-loop, main-rms, lfo-rnd, comp-preview and kit-ab. main-rms's OS 1.74 source is the same file as in v1.2.
results: Step 9: on the FX track's AMP page a loud pattern inverts the VOL label; it clears when the output gets quieter.

individualTestResults: VOL label inverts while the output is loud
Label clears when the output gets quieter

contextNote: Main OS hashes are the builds', not read back from the device. Modwerk links the released core-ar2 0.3 (6b97dfb3…, with #153), which differs from C3A4's core.
